bio.text: Analilia Mejia represents New Jersey's 11th Congressional District and serves on the Homeland Security and Small Business committees.
Born and raised in New Jersey, she is the daughter of Colombian and Dominican immigrants and lives in Glen Ridge.
She began her career as a union organizer, was director of the New Jersey Working Families Alliance, and was National Political Director for Bernie Sanders' 2020 presidential campaign.
She also served in the U.S. Department of Labor under President Biden and was Co-Executive Director of Popular Democracy.
